mapping.implementation: violin::figure renders independent peak-normalized mirrored Gaussian densities on shared linear/log axes. Constants use point-mass marks, empty populations retain labelled lanes, and nonpositive log populations are explicitly unavailable without subset filtering. Kernel tails alone are clipped on log axes. Bootstrap HTML integrates violin summaries grouped by full metric contract and resampling unit; old JSON defaults to isolated rows. analyze --format html supports --summary-scale linear/logarithmic. Direct Cargo estimates.html inherits linear violin summaries. Unified experiment HTML includes candidate violin summaries with and without baseline, reusing candidate analysis for comparison plots. Existing parameter-summary scale selection reaches unified and direct Cargo bootstrap violin rendering. report and direct Cargo accept --summary-scale without a numeric parameter; direct Cargo enables bootstrap HTML automatically and validates output/execution mode before workloads. Suite summary_scale, summary_scale_case and with_summary_scale_defaults provide lazy nearest-group inheritance and explicit linear overrides. Direct Cargo bootstrap HTML resolves selected case scales; explicit CLI scale overrides all registered cases. Rendering partitions scale groups without cloning retained bootstrap arrays. suite/group/bench attributes accept summary_scale linear/logarithmic; imported registration inherits the parent fallback while explicit child scales remain authoritative. Invalid and duplicate attribute values fail parsing. Suite run/test and direct Cargo save resolved case scales in versioned provenance metadata, outside measurement compatibility. analyze HTML restores per-case scales with explicit CLI override; legacy metadata defaults and invalid values are handled explicitly. Unified report restores case scales when no CLI override is provided; saved-scale parse errors produce an explicit unavailable section instead of silently choosing linear. Process-runner protocol merges per-case scale preferences by consensus, including legacy linear defaults; conflicts remain sticky, preserve measurements, and add one explanatory note. Original per-worker provenance is retained.

summary_estimator_audit.finding: Criterion input summary lines use arithmetic mean of per-batch normalized times. Airbug defaults currently use median of process medians; these are distinct estimators. Criterion throughput is formatter scaling of mean time, not mean/median of batch rates.
summary_estimator_audit.progress: Implemented chart API selection via SummaryPlot.estimator and CLI --summary-estimator process-median|mean in direct Cargo and runner report. Default remains process medians. Mean normalizes each batch before averaging, equally weights batches, uses complete populations, and computes throughput as ratio of mean normalized work to mean normalized time. CLI requires a summary parameter; captions identify estimator. Regression decisions are unaffected.
